p: And do you not learn it by itself,
a father can nullify … on his own.
a father can nullify the vows of his betrothed daughter on his own.
she binds herself with a bond in her father’s house, … disallow her,
she binds herself with a bond in her father’s house, her father can disallow her,
in the presence of a betrothed, … father nullifies … on his own, … is … necessary … where there is no betrothed?
in the presence of a betrothed, i.e., when she is betrothed, the father nullifies his daughter’s vows on his own, is it necessary to state that he can do so where there is no betrothed?
the father requires the betrothed’s … but … the betrothed can nullify … on his own.
the father requires the betrothed’s participation in order to nullify his daughter’s vows but that the betrothed can nullify them on his own.
